about565.heroCopy: We've built our name through victories, adapted when the challenge changed, and kept moving forward. We're proud of our strength, honest about our imperfections, and here to enjoy the game together.
about565.heroSubtitle: Competitive by nature. Respectful by choice.
about565.heroArtworkSuggestion: Suggested: state emblem, alliance group, or a cinematic battle banner
about565.trackRecordCopy: Our history gives us something to be proud of. It also reminds us that staying strong means continuing to adapt.
about565.battlesDescription: Optional: add Volcano War screenshots, victory records, or a battle collage
about565.storyCopy: Power got us here. Strategy keeps us growing.
about565.storyParagraphOne: For a long time, we were strong enough to bulldoze our way through events. Planning wasn't always necessary when our power spoke for itself.
about565.storyParagraphTwo: Then other states started catching up. We had to think differently, coordinate better, and learn to use our strengths more carefully. So we did — and the wins kept coming.
about565.storyParagraphThree: We're not perfectly organized, and we don't always get things right. We simply believe that yesterday's success should never stop us from improving today.
about565.strategySuggestion: Suggested: Volcano War map, alliance formations, or a planning screenshot
about565.lifeSubtitle: Quiet in the calm. Active when it counts.
about565.lifeCopy: We don't need to be online all day to care about our state. Real life comes first, but when an event starts, our people show up.
about565.rulesCopy: A strong state needs shared expectations. These rules help us protect active players, respect alliances, and work together.
about565.napSchedule: Saturday, Sunday and Monday · No looting within State 565, subject to the specific border-base rule below.
about565.napProtectDetail: No bases in State 565 may be looted during the state-wide NAP. This applies to everyone, including the top alliances and their farms.
about565.napParticipationDetail: NAP protection extends to alliances with high participation. We do not segregate alliances based on power alone.
about565.napReturnDetail: On Saturday, members whose bases are outside their alliance hive receive 48 hours to return. Bases still outside the hive after that period become eligible for looting under this rule, as they may have been inactive for days.
about565.napDefenseDetail: Alliance members may reinforce and defend a base that becomes eligible for looting. In practice, this process is rarely used against active players. It mainly helps recover resources from players who have quit the game, which can later be shared with the state.
about565.mergersCopy: We don't force alliances to merge. If an alliance struggles because of low activity, we may recommend a merger for the benefit of its members and the state. But every alliance has its own leadership, friendships, and reasons for its decisions. We offer advice, understand that circumstances differ, and respect each alliance's choices.
about565.culture: We fight to win. We never forget that it's a game.
about565.closingCopy: We're proud of our record, honest about what needs work, and ready for the next challenge. Seasons end, rankings change, and victories become memories. The people and experiences we share are what make it worthwhile.

achievements.svsDescription: The only state among 561–576 to remain undefeated in State vs. State, according to our record.
achievements.563Description: We faced State 563 twice and came away victorious on both occasions.
achievements.hardDescription: Our first Volcano War victory came in Hard Mode, facing three states at once.
achievements.twoVtwoDescription: In our second Volcano War, we fought alongside State 567 against State 571 and dominated the battle together.

principles.improveDescription: We were once strong enough to win through raw power alone. As others caught up, we learned to plan, coordinate, and fight smarter.
principles.realLifeDescription: We are not online around the clock. We have work, families, responsibilities, and lives outside the game. When events begin, we show up.
principles.banterDescription: We joke, tease, and compete. But there is a difference between having fun and making someone feel unwelcome. We believe that difference matters.
principles.peopleDescription: We want to win, but never at the cost of the community. No event or ranking is worth making people miserable in a game meant to be enjoyed.

intro.title: Welcome to the arena
intro.description: Survive as many waves as you can. Keep your survivor alive, clear the arena, and use every opening to reposition.

player.title: Your survivor
player.description: The glowing character is you. Your health is shown in the Vitals bar, so avoid contact with zombies.

movement.title: Move around
movement.description: Use your configured movement keys, or drag the left joystick on touchscreens. You can rebind keys in Settings. Move a short distance to practise.

aim.title: Aim and fire
aim.description: Point the mouse or drag the right joystick to change aim. Your weapon fires automatically in that direction. Try aiming somewhere new.

hud.title: Read the HUD
hud.description: Wave, Vitals, Eliminated, Score, Hostiles, and your bomb and turret inventories track the run. Use the bomb key or touch bomb button to use a bomb. Right-click or double-tap an open spot to deploy a turret. Collected temporary effects appear beneath the HUD.

enemies.title: Know your enemies
enemies.description: Walkers are slower and tougher. Runners are smaller, faster, and have less health. Keep moving and aim away from danger.

obstacles.title: Use the arena
obstacles.description: Crates and barricades block movement and can interrupt shots. Steer around them to create a clear path.

powerups.title: Power-up orbs
powerups.description: Health restores up to 25 health; damage doubles shot damage for 10s; rapid fire doubles shots for 8s; shield absorbs 60 damage for 12s. Collect up to five bombs, then press the bomb key or touch bomb button to deal 100 damage to nearby unobstructed zombies. Collect up to five turrets, then right-click or double-tap an open spot to place one for 12 seconds.

collectOrb.title: Collect an orb
collectOrb.description: Walk over an orb to collect it. Orbs drop after every two zombie eliminations; follow a glowing orb and collect one to see its effect. Bombs are stored until you press the bomb key or touch bomb button.

waves.title: Clear the wave
waves.description: Enemies arrive in waves. Defeat every zombie to clear a wave and earn its score bonus.

statPoints.title: Spend stat points
statPoints.description: Each cleared wave earns one stat point. Open the pause menu to spend points on weapon damage, fire rate, maximum health, or movement speed. Use minus to refund an allocated point.

pause.title: Pause and review
pause.description: The pause menu shows run statistics and active effects. Pause with Escape or the Pause button; resume, adjust settings, restart, or return to the menu.

completion.title: You are ready
completion.description: Move with WASD or arrow keys, aim with the mouse, and collect orbs while surviving each wave. Return to the main menu to start a fresh normal run.
